translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Kilisala paila Babiloni kala dadaimi
Biga mabigana paila Babilonia. Makawala utuyagila ekikipini oviloupakala, kabommayuyu bikaloubusi metoya valu mapilana kabokokola sainela.

Yeigu bogwa lagisi kilisala vavagi saina mwaugaga bikaloubusi, okilisala makwaina lagisi eikikasalaisi sesia deli eikikatumatasi deli eiyayoulasi. Mina Ilam tokwabilia, kusuyaisi kulumi! Mina Midia tokwabilia, kuvaulaisi valu kuvapataisi! E Yaubada igau bivitobu tutala kabommayuyu Babiloni leiyomituli.
E avaka lagisi deli lalagi metoya kilisala makwaina ivakasauwaigu kokola deli mmayuyu, kala mmayuyu makawala natana vivila eigigadi tutala bitapoi yamala.
E ikiuta nanogu, atatatuva deli agu kokola. Yeigu apipikwaku nani bikoyavi, mitaga gala avaka kala bwaina abani mesinaku wala kokola.

Okilisala agisi kwaitala paka leikatubiasaisi, deli moi iyavaisi paila matausina leidouwaisi bisilaisi. Matausina ikamkwamsi deli imomomsi. E saina nanakwa tokaraiwaga idou kawala, “Yokomi kumatoula! Kwatubiasaisi mi vayoula!”
E Guyau ilukwaigu kawala, “Mwa kunagi taitala toyausa biyuuyausa kadumalaga e kuluki matauna bilivali avaka avaka igigisi.
Kidamwa bigisi tomota isisilasi wa wosa ivalabilasi imeimaisi, e deli mimilisi isisilasi wa ase deli kameli, matauna ibodi bivitoki tolosisi bibwaina.”
E toyausa ikawota kawala, “Tomwaya, bogwa lawai kailoulegu agu yam agu bogi layuuyausa wala.”

Gala kwaitala momwa matausina tosisila wa wosa leivalabilasi leimaisi. E toyausa eikawau kawala, “Babiloni bogwa leidadaimi! Komwaidona minasina si yaubada tokolu leititaimamilasi bogwa leikatumkumkwaisi opwaipwaia.”
Wo, ulo tomota Isireli, yokomi bogwa leivakikilaimi makawala witi, mitaga tuta baisa bogwa lauyokaimi bulogala bwaina avaka bogwa lalagi metoya baisa Guyau Topeuligaga matauna Isireli la Yaubada.
Kala biga Edom
Biga mabigana paila Edom. Taitala ididouwaigu metoya Edom. Kawala, “Mwa toyausa, am makala kalu valu paila biyam? Kulukwaigu ammakala kalu valu.”
E yeigu avitakauloki kawagu, “Bogwa eiyumyam, mitaga igau bibogivau, e kidamwa magim bukukwatupoivau, kukwaimilavau kuma kukwatupoivauwaigu.”
Arebia kala biga
Biga mabigana paila Arebia. Yokomi mina Dedani, yokomi lokumilivalusi oviloupakala mapilana Arebia,
ibodi bukusakaisi kasi sopi matausina tomota tokadaka leiwokaiami. Yokomi mina Tema ibodi bukusakaisi kaula baisa matausina mina sisakaula metoya okabilia.
Tomota eisisakaulasi metoya kema kala kakata, kaiyala, deli goli komwaidona kabilia silagila.
Oluvi Guyau ilukwaigu kawala, “Olopola kwaitala wala taitu bibudoki komwaidona si togaga mina Kedara bogwa biwokuva.
Matausina tokwabisi kaiyala mina tuvaluwa mokwita olopola Kedara. Mitaga gala ibawasi matausina bikesasi mina mmomova. Yeigu Guyau Isireli la Yaubada bogwa lalivala.”
